Kit summary

Fate CubeBasic
Deals 200% DEF DMG to a single enemy, with a 70% chance to reduce the target's ATK by 20% for 2 turns and a 70% chance to reduce their DEF by 30% for 2 turns.
Shadow PlayActive
Deals 200% DEF DMG to an enemy and another 2 random enemies, with a 70% chance to inflict [Freeze] or a 70% chance to inflict [Silence] for 1 turn.
Queen of Eternal NightPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
Zyra gains 5 layers of [Eternal Night] at the beginning of each wave. Each layer increases Zyra's Effect RES by 10% and reduces the DMG she takes by 4%. 1 layer of [Eternal Night] is lost when she is inflicted with a control effect and 1 layer of [Eternal Night] is gained when she successfully inflicts a control effect. When a turn starts, for every enemy target under a control effect, Zyra restores self HP by 3% of Max HP.
Eternal Cube Lv.1When Zyra's [Eternal Night] is reduced due to a control effect, there is a 40% chance to cleanse all control effects from self.
Eternal Cube Lv.2Zyra gains an extra 25% Effect Hit.
Haunted NightActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 200% DEF DMG to all enemies, with a 60% chance to inflict [Freeze]/[Stun]/[Silence]/[Hypnotize]/[Horrify] on every target for 1 round .
Eternal Cube Lv.3Haunted Night: There is the same chance to additionally inflict [Block Buff] for 1 turn and a 50% chance to make the inflicted control effect cannot be blocked or removed.
